title: Smothered Chicken Thighs
steps: Pat thighs dry. Season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Brown in oil, 5 minutes a side. Set aside.
Cook onion in the drippings, add garlic. Stir in flour 1 minute.
Whisk in broth and milk. Return thighs. Cover and simmer 25 minutes until tender.

title: Weeknight Lemon Garlic Chicken Breasts
steps: Pound breasts even. Season.
Sear in oil 4 minutes a side. Add garlic 30 seconds.
Add lemon juice and broth. Simmer 5 minutes until cooked through.

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Simmer chicken in broth 15 minutes. Shred.
Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, beans, spices, broth, and chicken.
Simmer 10 minutes. Serve with crushed chips.

title: Weeknight Beef Chili
steps: Brown beef with onion. Drain extra fat.
Add garlic, tomatoes, beans, and spices.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.

title: Skillet Lasagna
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Stir in marinara, water, and broken pasta. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Dot with ricotta, cover with mozzarella, lid off heat 5 minutes.

title: Pork Chops with Skillet Apples
steps: Season chops. Brown in oil 4 minutes a side. Set aside.
Add apples, butter, cinnamon, and broth. Cook 5 minutes.
Return chops to the pan 3 minutes.

title: One-Pot Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya
steps: Brown sausage, then chicken. Set aside.
Cook onion, pepper, celery, garlic. Stir in rice 1 minute.
Add broth, tomatoes, seasoning, meat. Cover and simmer 22 minutes.

title: Shrimp Creole
steps: Cook rice.
Sauté onion, pepper, celery, garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes and seasoning. Simmer 15 minutes. Stir in shrimp 5 minutes until pink.

title: Ground Beef Tacos
steps: Brown beef with onion. Stir in spices.
Warm tortillas.
Fill with beef, tomato, lettuce, and cheese.

title: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, peppers, and onion. Toss chicken with spices.
Sear chicken in oil, then peppers and onion.
Serve in tortillas with lime.

title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
steps: Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, salt. Roll 16 meatballs.
Brown in oil. Add garlic and marinara. Simmer 15 minutes.
Boil spaghetti. Serve with sauce and parmesan.

title: Italian Sausage and Peppers
steps: Brown sausage. Slice if links.
Add peppers, onion, garlic.
Stir in tomatoes and seasoning. Simmer 15 minutes.

title: Oven-Fried Catfish
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Oil a sheet pan.
Mix cornmeal and spices. Press onto fish.
Bake 18–20 minutes until flaky.

title: Sheet-Pan Salmon and Broccoli
steps: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss broccoli with oil and salt. Roast 10 minutes.
Add salmon, lemon, pepper. Roast 12 minutes more.

title: Venison Chili
steps: Brown venison in oil with onion.
Add garlic, tomatoes, beans, spices.
Simmer 40 minutes. Works with trimmings or mystery grind.

title: Pan-Seared Venison Backstrap
steps: Bring meat to room temp. Season well.
Sear in hot oil 2–3 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Rest 8 minutes. Slice across the grain. Butter on the slices.

title: Slow Venison Shoulder Pot Roast
steps: Heat oven to 300°F. Brown roast in oil.
Add onion, tomato paste, broth. Cover.
Bake 2 1/2 hours. Add carrots and potatoes last 45 minutes.

title: Mystery Meat Tomato Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb unlabeled game or beef cubes
steps: Cook rice.
Brown meat cubes well. Add onion and pepper.
Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer 20 minutes until tender.

title: Oven BBQ Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Season thighs.
Bake 25 minutes. Brush with sauce.
Bake 15 minutes more until sticky and cooked through.

title: Red Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 lb dried red beans or 3 cans
steps: If dried, soak beans overnight or quick-soak.
Brown sausage. Add vegetables.
Add beans, broth, seasoning. Simmer 40 minutes. Serve over rice.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in oil. Set aside.
Fry rice and peas. Add soy.
Fold in eggs and green onions.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Slice steak thin. Mix soy and sugar.
Sear beef, set aside. Stir-fry broccoli and garlic.
Return beef with sauce 1 minute. Serve over rice.

title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Cook rice. Sauté onion and garlic.
Add curry powder, tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas, salt.
Simmer 15 minutes.

title: Greek Sheet-Pan Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°F.
Toss chicken and potatoes with oil, lemon, oregano, salt, garlic.
Roast 35 minutes.

title: Simple Lamb Stew
steps: Brown lamb in oil.
Add onion, broth, thyme, salt. Simmer 50 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes. Cook 25 minutes more.

title: Chicken in White Wine Pan Sauce
steps: Season and brown chicken in butter. Set aside.
Cook shallot. Deglaze with wine, add broth and thyme.
Return chicken 8 minutes.

title: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Sauté onion. Add beans and spices. Mash lightly.
Warm tortillas. Fill with beans, avocado, lime.

title: Sausage and White Bean Soup
steps: Brown sausage with onion.
Add garlic, beans, broth. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach 2 minutes.

title: Crispy Pork Shoulder Tacos
steps: Heat oven to 300°F. Rub pork with spices.
Add onion, garlic, orange juice. Cover and roast 3 hours.
Shred, broil 5 minutes for crisp edges. Serve in tortillas.

title: Ground Turkey Taco Skillet
steps: Brown turkey with onion.
Add beans, corn, chili powder, salt.
Top with cheese, lid 2 minutes.

title: Ham and Pinto Beans
steps: Cover beans and ham with water. Bring to a boil.
Add onion and garlic. Simmer 1 1/2 hours until creamy.
Salt at the end.

title: Crispy Duck Breast
steps: Score skin. Season.
Start skin-side down in a cold pan. Render 10–12 minutes.
Flip 3 minutes. Rest 8 minutes. Slice.

title: Salt-and-Pepper Roast Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken dry.
Rub with oil, salt, pepper. Stuff lemon and onion.
Roast 70 minutes to 165°F in the thigh. Rest 15 minutes.

title: Sunday Beef Stew
steps: Brown beef in oil in batches.
Add onion, tomato paste, broth, thyme, salt. Simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add carrots and potatoes 35 minutes more.

title: Garlic Shrimp over Pasta
steps: Boil pasta.
Sauté garlic in butter and oil. Add shrimp 3 minutes.
Toss with pasta, lemon, salt.

title: Pantry Tuna Pasta
steps: Boil pasta.
Sauté garlic in oil. Add tomatoes, oregano, salt.
Fold in tuna and pasta.

title: Sausage and Cabbage Skillet
steps: Brown sausage.
Add onion, cabbage, apples, salt.
Cover 12 minutes until tender.

title: Oven Jerk Chicken
steps: Mix spices, sugar, oil, garlic. Rub on chicken. Rest 20 minutes if you can.
Bake at 400°F 40 minutes.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic. Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in eggs. Cover 6–8 minutes until whites set.

title: Wild Hog Chili
steps: Brown hog with onion. Drain if very fatty.
Add garlic, tomatoes, beans, spices.
Simmer 45 minutes. Good for trimmings and mystery grind.

title: Skillet Dove with Peppers
steps: Cook bacon, set aside.
Sear dove in bacon fat 2 minutes a side.
Add onion and jalapeño 3 minutes. Crumble bacon over.

title: Squirrel and Potato Stew
steps: Brown squirrel in oil.
Add onion, broth, salt, pepper. Simmer 50 minutes.
Add potatoes and carrots 25 minutes more.

title: Leftover Meat Hash
steps: Dice potatoes and onion. Fry in oil until brown.
Add chopped leftover meat and salt.
Fry eggs on top if you want.
